articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Alibaba’s Expanding AI Ecosystem And What It May Mean For BABA Investors. Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE:BABA) has rolled out its new Qwen AI assistant app, extending its Qwen model family into a consumer facing product. The company has introduced advanced proprietary AI models, including Qwen3-Max-Thinking, aimed at more complex reasoning tasks. Alibaba reports orbital deployment of its AI models, describing them as operating in space for the first time.
